# glinet_reboot (Action)

Reboot the router. This is a one-shot action, not a managed resource. Requires `confirm = "REBOOT"`.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `confirm` (String) Must be `REBOOT`.
